watch.en: Preheat the oven and keep the door shut while the batter rises and sets.
watch.de: Den Ofen vorheizen und die Tür geschlossen halten, solange der Teig aufgeht und stockt.

why.en: A very hot oven sets the top before the batter has risen, and heat left in the food keeps cooking the centre after it comes out.
why.de: Ein sehr heißer Ofen lässt die Oberfläche stocken, bevor der Teig aufgegangen ist, und die Restwärme gart die Mitte nach dem Herausnehmen weiter.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Too high a temperature will cause the top to set before it is risen enough.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Do not open the oven until the cake has fully risen and the structure has set.

sources.title: Introduction to Baking and Pastries (Rink and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Therefore, if the center is set but not completely it will finish cooking once out of the oven.
